items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: You must be a pure bread Irishman.

ctx.x: I bet. Only family are fans. Because uh...

Just like up at... When I played up at the Kingley House. I was... I heard so much about the Irish Channel, you understand? I never was in trouble in my life. So... I was kind of leery about going up there and playing. For fear that I'd get mixed up with some of them Irishmen up there. And... So uh... The fella that had the job. He says, Oh, you don't have Jake Steven. He said, You don't have to worry. Them people ain't gonna bother you. He says, All you gotta do is sit upon your... Sit upon the stand and...…
You told me the other day about hearing a violin player named John Gould. John Gould, yeah.
